cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I drew that floating staircase last week. Mention the date.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can all see it now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I drew the handrail while you called it nonsense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Loud enough for the people using my prediction to get upstairs.

mechanism: A directs the volume and wording of recognition so a now-visible impossibility is credited to A's earlier prediction.
confusable: Unlike ordinary pride in a drawing, A insists on priority over former doubters and recognition by current users.
comparison: A public staircase and loud acknowledgment differ from a talking cupboard trying to introduce itself.
seedUse: Use the canonical drawing/date/handrail seed as context; the protected single remains unchanged while this pair's explicit commands are assessed separately.
